text:
Sam: FYI new int8 reranker bring-up showing an MRR hit on the holdout. NDCG@10 slightly up but MRR@10 down ~6.8%.
Priya: numbers?
Sam: baseline float MRR=0.477, int8 MRR=0.445, NDCG@10 float=0.682, int8=0.684. harness id run/2026-03-21/12
Jordan: could be small tokenisation/formatting differences amplifying rank ties. Any recent changes to candidate serialization?
Sam: I noticed mixed dashes and stray zero-width spaces in some candidates. Sample: "Installlatestpackage" and "Reset password ".
Priya: NBSP and control chars can change token boundaries. That'll affect softmax logits and reorder top1 often (MRR) while leaving overall NDCG similar.
Luca: what PTQ settings were used? per_channel? calibration samples?
Sam: job config: `quant_mode=int8_static, per_channel=false, calib_samples=2048, seed=7`
Priya: quick experiment: strip control chars + NFKC normalize then PTQ per_channel=true, calib_samples=8192. Local 1k probe: MRR rose from .446 -> .472.
Jordan: can you push a small bench diff? I'll run a 10k shadowbench A/B.
Sam: pushed fix PR and a small repro script: https://github.com/redwood-inference/bench/pull/801
eval-bot: shadowbench queued: sb-801 (10k holdout)
Priya: also ran ablation: only normalizer -> +2.1% MRR, only per_channel quant -> +1.0% MRR, both -> +3.5% MRR. So biggest single impact is the normaliser.
Sam: plan: 1) add NFKC + control-char strip to serializer, 2) adopt per_channel PTQ by default for rerank models, 3) expand CI smoke to include weird-whitespace injection, 4) re-run full bench and ship if green.
Jordan: assigned: @Sam add serializer tests and bench regen, @Priya run quant sweep and upload traces, @Luca monitor shadowbench and collect kernel traces.
Luca: noted. Also adding a tiny synthetic to rerank-smoke asserting MRR delta <1% on injected noise.
Sam: will open PRs this morning. Thanks all.
eval-bot: sb-801 complete: patched vs baseline: NDCG@10 +0.15%, MRR@10 +3.4% (patched better)
Priya: recommend merge after perf sign-off and add backcompat note for dataset consumers.
Sam: PR #803 created with normalization + tests + bench regen. Ready for review.
